verdict.line: You lose if you walk into Ornn's E (Searing Charge) off cooldown near a wall; you win because Darius holds both the raw winrate (56.8% over 81 games) and the solo-kill edge in this matchup.

brief.thesis: Darius's E (Apprehend) has 535 range against Ornn's 450-range E (Searing Charge) and 1-range Q (Volcanic Rupture) melee swing, so Darius dictates engage distance for most of the laning phase. The one reversal is Ornn's E-into-terrain shockwave, which knocks up and punishes a careless dive — everything else in his kit is a slow or a self-buff, not a hard answer to Darius's pull-stack-execute pattern.

theirWindow.when: Q (Volcanic Rupture) slow lands near a wall
theirWindow.what: Back off immediately — if Ornn's E is also up he can charge through you into terrain, triggering the shockwave that deals damage and knocks you up, turning your dive into his trade.

yourWindow.when: Ornn's E (Searing Charge) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Walk him down and land E (Apprehend) — his only gap-closer/disengage is gone for 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s, so you can stack Hemorrhage with Q and W (Crippling Strike) and threaten R (Noxian Guillotine) with no answer coming back.

start.why: 52.9% win rate over 87 games and the highest pick rate (82.1%) — the extra AD and sustain let you win the all-in trades before Ornn's Living Forge bonus Armor/MR stacks up.

boots.why: 57.1% win rate over 42 games — Ornn still auto-attacks in extended trades, and the flat damage reduction blunts those exchanges better than tenacity does this early.

core.why: The active haste closes the gap after your E pull and resets before his E (Searing Charge) does, keeping you on top of him through the trade.

runes.keystoneWhy: Fits the sustained skirmish this matchup is — Ornn can't peel you off once E (Apprehend) connects, so a stacking adaptive-damage keystone outperforms a one-shot burst keystone in these longer trades.

summoners.why: 58.5% win rate at 79.6% pick rate — Ghost keeps pace with his E (Searing Charge) dash and lets you stay attached through the slow from his Q, which a static lane like this needs more than Ignite's early kill threat.

playing.title: Pull before he charges
playing.detail: Land E (Apprehend, 535 range) the instant he's in range rather than waiting — it outranges his E (Searing Charge, 450 range) and Q melee swing (1 range), so you get the first hit every time.

playing.title: Never dive into a wall
playing.detail: If Ornn's E is up and there's terrain behind you, don't commit — his charge collision creates a shockwave that knocks up and damages you, flipping your engage into his.

playing.title: Track his E cooldown, not his mana
playing.detail: Ornn's E (Searing Charge) is his only gap-closer and disengage at 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s cooldown — once it's down, there's nothing stopping your stack-and-execute pattern.

playing.title: All-in once Hemorrhage hits 5 stacks
playing.detail: Your passive enrages and grants massive bonus AD at max stacks — chain Q (Decimate) and auto-attacks until he's stacked, then W (Crippling Strike) to slow the retreat before Guillotine.

playing.title: Dive post-6 for the solo kill
playing.detail: Solo-kill advantage is yours here — R (Noxian Guillotine) deals true damage that scales with Hemorrhage stacks and refreshes its cooldown on a kill, so a clean level-6 all-in can snowball immediately.

playing.title: Respect his ult only in teamfights
playing.detail: Call of the Forge God has a 140/120/100/100/100s cooldown and is built for group fights, not 1v1 lane — don't play scared of it solo, just don't stand still near minions once he's 6.

playing.title: Fight for Summoner trades
playing.detail: OP.GG's own read on this matchup is to pressure Ornn whenever he steps up — either kill him outright or force a Flash/Ghost burn, since your lane win rate (56.8% over 81 games) comes from exactly this kind of forced exchange.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and all win rates/sample sizes above are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the ability breakdowns, timing windows, and tactical reasoning are my own read on the matchup, not pulled from aggregate stats.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of Ornn’s (Q)-(E) combo while applying pressure. Fight Ornn whenever he steps in range to kill him or to at least get a Summoner’s Spell from him.
